title: Concept: Jenkins stack trace in a response
description: A Jenkins (hudson) class name in an exception in a response gives every reader the same visibility the bank has internally: The stack names the Jenkins version line, the plugin that failed and the build directory, which is the reconnaissance an attacker needs before targeting the automation server.
applicability: Build servers hold deployment credentials and source; a version fingerprint is the first step against them.
risk: Automation infrastructure should not describe itself to unauthenticated clients.
